summary: No operator page states anything checkable: ghenynook.com still redirects to spam, the Facebook page's About says only 'Short and long term sites available' with phone (304) 536-9017 (last visible post July 4, 2023), and the Greenbrier County CVB listing is a directory. flags: Presence rule, marginal: no operator website (Facebook is not one). ghenynook.com 301-redirects through buybotoxonlines.com, gtavaccine.com, sterifre.com and others (2026-10-21), and the Greenbrier CVB listing's 'visit website' button still points at it. The Facebook page's last visible post is July 4, 2023. The only thing that passes is the Google Maps listing: at 37.93804,-80.16938 (~270 m from the pin, the WV-92 entrance), not marked closed, phone (304) 536-9017, 4.7 with exactly 25 reviews (the minimum). Price indicator is RV Life $$ only.

Long-stay test (AWH five-test rule) likely fails: Facebook 'Short and long term sites available', CVB 'Short term and long term site rentals are available. Please call ahead to make arrangements', a Google review 'We stayed from December-April', a Facebook comment from 'lot A14', and Esri imagery of ~100 travel trailers. A long-stay park needs a posted nightly rate or a booking site to show nights are really for sale; the only nightly rate anywhere ($35, 30-amp W/E/S) is the operator's 2021 page, now dead, and booking is by phone. RV Life $$ does not stand in for a long-stay park. Suggest drop, or a phone call to confirm a nightly rate.
website field holds the Facebook page and a CVB directory listing (greenbrierwv.com), neither an operator website.
